notes: Scan 030, whole sheet: upright mathematical text on otherwise blank paper. There is no printed letterhead, no date and no dark authorial page number at the head. The pale 29 at the extreme lower left is retained as marginal/archival foliation, not mspage.

The line count is 18: fifteen running-text baselines, one raised replacement baseline, and two diagram-object rows. The isolated p/i connector labels and the two handwritten numbering items are separately inventoried rather than counted as additional text lines.

Scan 030, paragraph: the source proposes recovering the homotopy type of X by an amalgamated construction involving the three written spaces. It then proposes a van Kampen statement for the written fundamental-groupoid diagram. This is an account of the manuscript's proposal; no proof or general van Kampen theorem was checked in this first reading.

Scan 030, lines 6–8: the replacement espaces is above the struck word, and the two infinitesimal spaces are said to be de nature infinitésimale. The singular ending is retained without changing agreement. The cancelled types|topos remains open under the rule that every letter must be readable before resolving a doubt inside a cancellation.

Scan 030, line 10: the written capital Π_i is retained, with i≥2. No mathematical expectation of lowercase π is used to repair it. The source's ordinary line-end division is essen- / tiellement; the prose transcription joins that divided word, while second box B007 retains the literal end-of-baseline essen-.

Scan 030, diagram (8): p has a small angular bowl at the top of a long stem, rather than a secure free rho loop. The five Π signs in the diagram and the inline Π are read as capitals. All five Π subscripts are 1, both V subscripts are Y,X, and stars occur only on the upper-left V and the lower-left X in the diagram.

Scan 030, upper-right diagram annotation: p12 distinguishes two separate curved runs above an independently drawn leftward arrow. A textual approx decoration is used above that arrow. The second curve was unresolved in the whole-diagram crop p08, so p12 is a necessary detail crop of an open place, not a second crop of a decided reading.

Scan 030, diagram geometry: the upper connector has one short upturned terminal; the left vertical has a rounded foot. The right vertical has six separate short marks followed by a shallow rounded cup. The lower connector has five dashes followed by a detached >. These are reproduced as their visible strokes rather than completed conventional heads. The lower parentheses enclose the broken connector and Π_1X together, with their unequal heights retained by textual delimiter nodes. Diagram objects, parentheses and the approx decoration remain textual mathematical nodes; only genuine connector strokes are drawn as paths.

Scan 030, above/right of the p shaft: two isolated small dots are off the shaft and have no aligned attachment or formula role. They are excluded as stray ink. Pale paper texture, creases and background specks are also not treated as text.

H's final explanatory note about the square is editorial. It is excluded from the source transcription and is not a local uncertainty mark. The only actual local H doubt relevant to a correction is its ill mark for the raised espaces.

Crop p04 initially clipped the bottom of the f loop in infinitésimale. Supplement p11 includes that complete word and its closing punctuation before the phrase reading was closed. p10 is the same-page live-types comparison for the still-open struck word. No other page was inspected.

Second boxes B001/B002 and B008/B009 split the two quoted phrases at their original line boundaries. Their readings give the scoped phrase segments, not incidental partial ink from adjacent lines at crop edges. B010 contains the complete diagram and its number, not isolated uncertain tips.

Root independently viewed the original and all p01–p12 and agreed with the stated resolutions, retained cancellation doubt, two-curve decoration, stroke counts and stray-dot exclusion before this report was finalised.

Main reader viewed original and all p01–p12, checked full TeX/report, and required the lower unequal parentheses to remain text-node delimiters. Espaces and capital Pi resolve; deleted types/topos stays open. The separate two-wave decoration, partial terminals, six vertical marks, five lower dashes and parenthesis scope are confirmed. No mathematical proof event claimed.
